title: Kenworth K200 FUPS Road Train Bullbar #7
description: Kenworth K200 high tensile aluminium FUPS Bullbar. Full depth channel with vents to cool oil cooler. Custom extruded 'C' bar spotlight mount fitted to lower centre pipe. 76mm heavy duty high tensile aluminium pipes, main pipes are one piece passing through drilled heavy duty 100mm wide uprights, 88mm pipes optional fitting in lieu of 76mm. Heavy duty tow pin in steel backing plate. Flip over combination aluminium Road Train signs. Optional combination daylight running/indicator repeater lights can be mounted in the outer uprights.
